map.：AKE（空运集装箱，适配窄体/宽体下货舱）典型内容积约 4.3 m³、最大毛重: : An AKE (an air freight container that fits the lower deck of narrow-body and wide-body aircraft) typically has an internal volume of about 4.3 m3 and a maximum gross weight of about 1588 kg (PAG pallets are higher). When loading, check the aircraft door dimensions and floor load limits to avoid the situation where the cargo fits but the center of gravity cannot be worked out.

map.ULD 和集装器是一回事吗？: Are ULD and unit load device the same thing?
map.ULD（Unit Load Device）是统称，含集装箱（如 AKE）与集装板: ULD (Unit Load Device) is a generic term covering containers (such as AKE) and pallets (such as PMC/PAG, where a net secures loose cargo on the pallet). Selection depends on the aircraft cargo position (container position or pallet position) and the size limits.
map.最大毛重超限会怎样？: What happens if the maximum gross weight is exceeded?
map.超出 ULD 标定毛重或飞机地板载荷/货舱门限制，可能导致结构损伤或无法装机。配: Exceeding the ULD rated gross weight or the aircraft floor load or cargo door limits may cause structural damage or make loading impossible. Loading must check weight, dimensions and center of gravity together, with the air waybill and load sheet prevailing.
